title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
description: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

title: Ports denied request to land 120 migrants in RNLI boats
description: The King's Harbour Master and Southampton Port both declined to allow migrants ashore on Sunday.

title: Trump shares misleading video of King and fainting worker
description: The president shares a misleading video which appears to show Charles shrugging and walking away from a man who fainted during a royal visit.

title: Glastonbury confirms ticket sale dates - and highest ever price
description: The festival will return in June after taking a fallow year, but tickets have topped £400 for the first time.

title: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
description: A 78-year-old British woman is facing deportation for failing to fill out a Brexit residence application on time.

title: Prince George attends first day at Eton College
description: The 13 year old was dropped off at the all-boys boarding school by his parents, Prince William and Princess Catherine of Wales.

title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
description: It is the latest in a string of high-profile art thefts in Europe that has again put the security of museums and galleries in the spotlight.

title: Monty Don to leave Gardeners' World after more than 20 years
description: The presenter said it had been "deeply rewarding" but added that "now is the right time for a change".

title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
description: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.
